Add ginger, garlic, sliced pepper, carrot and mangetout to pork and stir-fry 3-4 minutes. Blend cornflour with soy, sweet chilli sauce and a little water; add to pan with drained noodles. Toss over heat until sauce thickens and pork is fully cooked.

Add drained chickpeas and fresh tomato wedges, warm through and finish with coriander. Serve with rice.

cooking_instructions: Cook rice according to packet directions. Cut aubergine into wedges and brown in batches in a little oil, 2-3 minutes per side; set aside. Soften sliced onion, add chilli and spices, then stir in coconut milk, chopped tomatoes and water. Simmer 25 minutes to reduce. Return aubergine with drained chickpeas and simmer another 5 minutes until tender. Serve over rice.

recipe_name: Vegetable Jalfrezi with Squash and Cauliflower
cooking_instructions: Cook sliced onion gently in oil for 8-10 minutes, then mix in jalfrezi paste. Add cubed squash, cauliflower florets, half a stock cube, passata and water. Simmer 20 minutes. Add peppers and drained chickpeas and cook 15-20 minutes more until vegetables soften. Meanwhile cook rice. Swirl yoghurt and coriander into the curry off the heat and serve with rice.

Add cubed paneer, drained chickpeas, coconut milk, spinach, half a stock cube and water. Bring to a simmer for about 20 minutes until thick. Stir in mango chutney and lemon juice and serve with rice.

recipe_name: Salmon Thai Red Curry Noodle Soup
cooking_instructions: Bring water and a chicken stock cube to a boil in a saucepan; stir in red curry paste. Add rice noodles and simmer for about 8 minutes, adjusting for packet directions. Add sliced mushrooms and baby corn for 2 minutes. Add bite-size salmon pieces and gently simmer 3-5 minutes until cooked. Remove from heat, season with lime, soy and sugar, and scatter coriander over bowls.

recipe_name: Turkey Meatballs in Fennel Tomato Sauce
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 3 garlic cloves. Combine turkey mince, breadcrumbs and half the crushed garlic, shape into meatballs and chill 10 minutes. Soften onion, diced carrot and remaining garlic in half the oil for 5-6 minutes. Add fennel seeds briefly, then tomatoes and puree; simmer 15 minutes. Fry meatballs in remaining oil for 8-10 minutes until fully cooked, then warm through in sauce. Boil spaghetti according to packet directions and serve together.

Stir-fry carrot, pepper and mangetout in oil for 3-4 minutes. Add sliced cooked pork, prawns, noodles and remaining sauce; toss 2-3 minutes until prawns are fully heated and noodles hot.

Warm drained cooked lentils according to packet directions, combine with roasted vegetables and halloumi, and finish with torn basil.

Sear thick halloumi slices in a hot non-stick pan until golden on both sides. Whisk lemon juice with olive oil and chopped mint, toss through warm potatoes and peas, then fold in rocket and top with halloumi.

recipe_name: Turkey Korma Meatballs with Sugar Snaps
cooking_instructions: Cook rice according to packet directions. Mix turkey mince with a spoon of korma paste, shape into small meatballs and brown in oil for 5 minutes. In a saucepan soften chopped onion with remaining paste for 5 minutes. Add half a stock cube, water and coconut milk; bring to a simmer. Add meatballs and cook for 10-12 minutes until fully cooked. Add mangetout and halved tomatoes for the final 2 minutes, then scatter almonds over.

recipe_name: Sticky Lime Pork and Mangetout Noodles
cooking_instructions: Mix honey with lime zest and juice; toss with thinly sliced pork and marinate 10 minutes. Cook noodles following packet directions. Thinly slice radishes, mangetout and carrot and combine with coriander. Lift pork from marinade and stir-fry in oil for 3-5 minutes until cooked. Boil reserved marinade in the pan for at least a minute. Serve pork and sauce over noodles with crisp vegetables.

recipe_name: Sweet and Sour Pineapple Pork with Rice
cooking_instructions: Cook rice according to packet directions. Mix cornflour with pineapple juice or water, tomato puree, soy, sugar and vinegar to make sauce. Stir-fry thin pork strips in hot oil until browned, then remove. Stir-fry pepper for 2 minutes; add pineapple and most spring onions briefly. Add sauce and simmer until glossy. Return pork and cook until fully cooked, then serve over rice with remaining spring onion.

recipe_name: Creamy Beef Mushroom Potato Crust Pie
cooking_instructions: Brown diced stewing beef in oil for about 10 minutes; set aside. Soften onion for 7 minutes, then mushrooms for 3 minutes. Add tomato puree and flour, cook 1 minute, then return beef with half a stock cube and water. Simmer gently covered for about 2 hours until beef is tender. Boil potatoes for 10 minutes, cool slightly and coarsely grate. Put filling in an oven dish, cover with grated potato and dot with butter. Bake at 170 C fan for 30 minutes until crisp.

cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 2 garlic cloves. Heat oil in a large frying pan and stir-fry diced chicken for 4-5 minutes until browned. Toss for 2-3 minutes until noodles are hot and chicken is fully cooked.

recipe_name: Air Fryer Sweet Potato Chickpea Curry
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 2 garlic cloves. Heat air fryer to 200 C. Toss cubed sweet potato with oil and air-fry 15 minutes until nearly tender. Add chopped onion and cook 5 minutes. Transfer to an air-fryer-safe tin, mix in ginger and garlic and cook 2 minutes. Stir in curry paste and drained chickpeas; cook another 4-5 minutes. Add tomatoes and cook 8-12 minutes until sauce thickens and potato is tender. Meanwhile cook rice; serve curry with coriander.
